BiblicalUsage: Kanac is to gather — to collect, to enfold, to bring together. The Preacher gathered silver and gold and singers; there is a time to cast away stones and a time to gather stones together; the LORD builds up Jerusalem and gathers together the outcasts of Israel; and Esther says, go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gathering is God's work as much as scattering is His judgment. He gathers the outcasts, He gathers His people to fast and pray, and one day He will gather them all home.
